item.title: Some Notes on Cookies
item.description: What attributes should a cookie have? When a cookie has the HttpOnly attribute, it can only be sent over HTTP (or HTTPS) and can't be accessed by client-side JavaScript. This is an effective defense against cross-site scripting (XSS), because an attacker can't read an HttpOnly cookie by injecting malicious JavaScript. The Secure attribute says a cookie may only be sent over a secure HTTPS…
